name: smartbistro-ai
description: SmartBistro AI fullstack app with Express backend, React frontend, and Neon/Postgres deployment support.

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm run install-all && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
